# uapi_service_recover (Action)

Starts a service again when procd gave up on one of its instances, through `POST /uapi/services/{name}/recover`. procd gives up on an instance that dies too often soon after a start: a write then warns that a daemon is down, and `data.uapi_diagnostics` lists the instance under `stopped_instances`. uapi stops and starts the whole service once, so the instances of the service that still run restart too. It starts nothing when procd gave up on no instance. Run it with `terraform apply -invoke=action.uapi_service_recover.<name>`, or from the `action_trigger` of a resource. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later. The token needs `uapi:services:rw`, or `rw` on a domain whose writes reload the service, such as `dhcp:rw` for dnsmasq.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Start dnsmasq again after a write warned that procd gave up on it:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.uapi_service_recover.dnsmasq
action "uapi_service_recover" "dnsmasq" {
  config {
    service = "dnsmasq"
  }
}

# Or run it after each update of the DHCP settings.
resource "uapi_dhcp_dnsmasq" "this" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_update]
      actions = [action.uapi_service_recover.dnsmasq]
    }
  }
}

# Each instance that procd gave up on, until a recover or a restart.
data "uapi_diagnostics" "this" {}

check "no_stopped_daemon" {
  assert {
    condition     = length(data.uapi_diagnostics.this.stopped_instances) == 0
    error_message = "procd gave up on: ${join(", ", [for i in data.uapi_diagnostics.this.stopped_instances : "${i.service}/${i.instance}"])}"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service` (String) Service to start again: `dnsmasq`, `lldpd`, `mwan3`, `odhcpd`, `prometheus-node-exporter-lua`, `snmpd`, `sysntpd`, `unbound` or `vnstat`. uapi answers 404 for another name, `network`, `uhttpd` and `dropbear` included: a stop of one of them cuts off the request or the management SSH session.
